notes.content:
解决使用毒杖造成奔溃的问题。（没找到奔溃原因，就从根源上把毒杖效果直接换了。）

Note: This version update will affect the archive of the old version.After the update, you need to delete the old version archive in the settings, otherwise there will be a problem of not displaying some trap information.
Solution: 1. Overall increase the experience value and the number of gold coins obtained.
               2. This version adds a console.
                ctrl+1    Increase gold coins
                ctrl+2    Level up
                ctrl+4    Pass directly（Press the number on the keypad first）

Optimize the interface ui effect 
Brave part of the range of skills to reduce the range 
Slightly reduce the number of heroes 
Increase the damage of the brave 
Increase the life of some monsters

Optimized Thunder Staff, added splitting effect

Increase the duration of the ladder staff.

The attack method of the trap ‘ice pool’ has been changed from ‘ice bomb’ to ‘ice fountain’ for continuous range damage. 
Warcraft ‘Stone Demon’ optimizes the effect of attacking stones, 
Expansion of the cannonball contact range of the "Ghost Ship" of Warcraft

Warcraft ‘Life Slime’ lowers the price, lowers the attack: 30→25, lowers life, and narrows the range of skills.

其他一些数据调整。
修改部分bug。

The overall optimization of the level scene is carried out to improve a more three-dimensional combat method.
Reduce the price and life of remote monsters as a whole.
Reduce the attack of melee monsters overall.
Slightly reduce the number of heroes in each round.
The price of Warcraft "Dark Knight" has been increased by 130→150. Added new skill ‘Summon’ (17% chance to summon random monsters).
Optimize the distance of "Dark Knight" following the player.
Some other data adjustments.
